_doc: The character creator (UI/SMRCharCreator, docs/adr/0009-user-interface.md). The rules (stat range and points, the 45 spell/skill points, the legal name characters) are the server's and live in Net/MRCharInfo.h; what the server offers comes in its BP_CHARINFO. Here: the words on each page and the stat presets. The presets' numbers are the original creator's (module/char/charstat.c); the text is ours. Stats are in the order Might, Intellect, Stamina, Agility, Mysticism, Aim. MRUIReload re-reads it.
title: Customize your character

prompts.name: Choose a name of 3 to 30 letters. Letters, numbers, spaces and these symbols are allowed: _ ' ! @ $ ^ & * ( ) + = : [ ] { } ; / ? | < >
prompts.description: Describe your character (others see this when they look at you):
prompts.spells: Pick the spells you start out knowing.
prompts.spells_rule: Shal'ille and Qor spells can't be chosen together.
prompts.skills: Pick the skills you start out with.

stats.name: Might
stats.desc: How much you can carry and how hard you hit.

stats.name: Intellect
stats.desc: How fast you learn spells and skills; the higher magics need it.

stats.name: Stamina
stats.desc: How well you hold up when hurt or tired. Kraanan's spells draw on it.

stats.name: Agility
stats.desc: Dodging blows, and some fighting and defensive arts.

stats.name: Mysticism
stats.desc: Gaining and restoring mana. Faren, Shal'ille and Qor rely on it.

stats.name: Aim
stats.desc: Landing your attacks; essential for bows and other ranged weapons.

presets.name: Hybrid
presets.desc: An archer who casts from three schools
